description: List your Robinhood Chain copy-trade rules. Each rule mirrors 1+ source wallets and emits a signal (webhook and/or the rhc:copytrade:signals WS channel) when they trade on chain 4663. Under source_admission 'any_wallet' (production since 2026-10-04) any valid 0x wallet fires, KOL or not; under the legacy 'kol_only' engine only tracked KOL wallets (/rhc/kol/wallets) fire. Returns id, name, source_wallets, min_trade_eth, only_action, sizing_mode, sizing_amount, delivery_mode, webhook_url, is_active, source_admission and operational_state (separate from is_active: 'eligible', or under any_wallet the infrastructure states monitoring_pending / monitoring_unavailable / source_capacity_unavailable; legacy kol_only: no_tracked_sources = can never fire, unknown = tracking read failed). source_wallets_tracked / source_wallets_untracked are deprecated KOL enrichment, still filled. Rule caps are PER CHAIN and do not consume the Solana copy-trade budget: PRO 3 rules / 5 wallets each, ULTRA 20 / 50, BUSINESS 100 / 250. Tier: PRO+.
name: rhc_copytrade_list
